info.name: Epic Wedplanner API
info.description: Epic Wedplanner authentication, service catalog, vendor KYC, vendor business profiles and capabilities, normalized cities, and public vendor discovery. Import the matching Postman environment. For the vendor-foundation flow: create or select an active city, submit and approve vendor KYC, review/update the vendor profile, then open the public profile by its saved slug.

request.description: Copy the OTP from the email into emailOtp. Verification does not sign the user in.
Saves vendor access token, refresh token, and user ID to the active Postman environment.
Google ID token must be issued for GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. role is needed only for a new account.
Rotates the vendor refresh token and saves the new access and refresh tokens to the active environment.
Can also use the httpOnly refresh cookie.
Run this after KYC approval with the vendor token. It uploads the public company logo and saves its url/publicId as companyLogoUrl/companyLogoPublicId for the business-profile update request.
Uploads the PAN image to Cloudinary and returns url/publicId. It does not write a KYC document row; the final Submit KYC request saves it.
Uploads the Aadhaar image to Cloudinary and returns url/publicId. It does not write a KYC document row; the final Submit KYC request saves it.
Confirms that the authenticated vendor can access vendor-only routes.
Validates and normalizes PAN format only. Nothing is saved to the database.
Validates Aadhaar format and returns only its masked normalized value. Nothing is saved to the database.
Validates and normalizes GSTIN format only. Nothing is saved to the database.
Validates and normalizes CIN format only. Nothing is saved to the database.

Before submitting KYC, an admin must create supported cities and the vendor frontend must load them with GET /api/v1/cities. Submit the vendor's selected active operating city as the required primaryCityId. The legal businessAddress separately requires city and countryCode; the current India-only API accepts and normalizes countryCode as IN. The business-address city may differ from the primary operating city. The request validates and saves the complete KYC form and all document rows in one transaction. PAN and Aadhaar are required. GST and CIN may be added under documents with number, url, and publicId. Each asset must come from this vendor's matching Cloudinary KYC upload folder.
Confirms that the authenticated admin can access admin-only routes.
Approves the submitted KYC, initializes the vendor business profile, and creates approved capabilities from the submitted subcategories. The generated public profile slug is saved as vendorSlug.

item.name: Public service catalog
item.description: Read-only service catalog endpoints for public pages. No authentication is required. Create the sample category and subcategory from the Admin service catalog folder first if the database is empty.

request.description: Returns active categories with active subcategories. Supports search, id, slug, and offeringKind=SERVICE|VENUE_PROPERTY; remove search when it is not needed.

item.name: Get selected public category with subcategories

request.description: Use this after a public user selects a category. The response includes the selected category and all of its subcategories.

item.name: List public subcategories for selected category

request.description: Returns subcategories belonging to the selected category and matching search. Exact id and slug filters are also supported. Remove search when it is not needed.
Returns one subcategory and its parent service category.

item.name: Admin service catalog
item.description: Admin-only CRUD for service categories and subcategories. Run Create categories first, then create subcategories separately using the saved category ID.

request.description: Creates categories only. offeringKind separates normal services from physical venue properties; isActive controls public visibility. Create subcategories separately using the saved serviceCategoryId. If any category fails, nothing is created.
Returns paginated categories with complete subcategories and _count.subcategories. Supports search, id, slug, offeringKind=SERVICE|VENUE_PROPERTY, and isActive=true|false.
Returns one service category and its complete subcategories array.

Updates one category only. offeringKind accepts SERVICE or VENUE_PROPERTY; isActive=false hides it from the public catalog without deleting it. Update subcategories separately with PATCH /admin/service-subcategories/:id.
Deletes the category only when it has no subcategories. If subcategories exist, the API returns 409 Conflict. Delete them or move them to another category first.

Creates multiple subcategories under one existing category in a single transaction. Each item may include description, imageUrl, imagePublicId, and isActive. The original single-subcategory body is also supported.
Updates one subcategory only. serviceCategoryId is optional and moves it to another category; isActive=false hides it from public selection without deleting it.

item.name: Vendor business profile
item.description: Vendor-only profile endpoints. GET is available while the KYC-built profile is still a draft. PATCH and capabilities require APPROVED KYC. Create/select an active city and approve the vendor KYC before running the update request.

request.description: Returns the authenticated vendor's own business profile, including private management fields such as logoPublicId and profile status. This is not the public marketplace response.

item.name: Update and publish my business profile

body.raw:
{
  "businessName": "Royal Events",
  "about": "Wedding planning, venue assistance, and decoration services for memorable celebrations.",
  "logoUrl": "{{companyLogoUrl}}",
  "logoPublicId": "{{companyLogoPublicId}}",
  "primaryCityId": "{{cityId}}",
  "profileStatus": "ACTIVE"
}

request.description: Requires APPROVED KYC and an active primaryCityId. Run Upload company logo first to populate companyLogoUrl and companyLogoPublicId. logoUrl and logoPublicId must always be sent together; set both to null to remove a saved logo. ACTIVE requires businessName, about, primaryCityId, and the server-generated slug. Vendors cannot set SUSPENDED.

Requires APPROVED KYC. Returns normalized capabilities created from the KYC service-subcategory selections; capabilities describe what the vendor is approved to offer and are not marketplace listings.

item.name: Public vendor profiles
item.description: Unauthenticated marketplace-safe vendor discovery and detail. Only vendors with an active account, APPROVED KYC, an ACTIVE profile, and an active primary city are returned. KYC documents, document numbers, legal addresses, contact details, and internal management fields are excluded.

request.description: Returns data.vendors and data.pagination without authentication. Only active accounts with approved KYC, an ACTIVE profile, and an active primary city are listed. Optional filters are page, limit, search, cityId, serviceCategoryId, serviceSubcategoryId, and offeringKind=SERVICE|VENUE_PROPERTY; remove filters that are not needed. Each vendor includes vendorId and safe public profile, city, and active approved service data. The first result's slug is saved as vendorSlug for the detail request.
Run List public vendors or Update and publish my business profile first so vendorSlug is saved. The response includes vendorId, the public profile, primary city, and active approved services only.

item.name: Public cities
item.description: Read-only normalized city lookup for KYC/profile forms and future marketplace filters. Public lists always return active cities only.

request.description: Supports page, limit, search, stateName, and countryCode. Public results are restricted to active cities. The first result is saved as cityId for the profile update flow.
Returns one normalized city by the cityId saved by a city list/create request.

item.name: Admin cities
item.description: Admin-only city management. Cities are disabled with isActive=false rather than deleted once referenced by vendor profiles.

request.description: Creates a normalized city and saves its ID as cityId for the vendor-profile flow. A unique slug is generated by the server.
Supports page, limit, search, stateName, countryCode, and isActive=true|false. Unlike the public list, admins may include inactive cities by omitting isActive.
Updates one or more city fields. Send isActive=false to disable a city without deleting referenced profile data.
Uses the implemented PUT alias to update city fields. The current API accepts partial or complete update bodies for both PATCH and PUT.
Confirms that the authenticated super admin can access super-admin-only routes.
